title: Rob's Non-Vanilla Experience
description: My own non-vanilla experience, in a modpack format.
body:
When I was a youngster and played Minecraft for the first time, I craved for a "Realistic" experience: big and large valleys, awe-inspiring mountains, memorable landscapes, the possibility to create beautiful and functional cities and highways... but just until now (and also having a good computer to run them all) I have the collection of mods to make that happen, and a way to share to friends and people who might want to try it.

Of course, I want to deeply thank the authors of all the mods used in this modpack, and also Modrinth as a way to share and easily update the mods.

It's not a Vanilla experience, hence the name. Hope you can find it relaxing, inspiring or whatever, Thanks for reading! :)
